This name symbolizes the importance placed on the Quran as a source of guidance, and the commitment required to obtain such knowledge.

The person named Haafizah has dedicated time, effort, and discipline to learn and memorize the Quran. This level of devotion to the sacred text is seen as a way to draw closer to Allah and receive His blessings. Additionally, the ability to recite the Quran from memory allows for a deeper connection to the text and a stronger foundation in faith.
